summary_ja: 量子半導体向けSi-28・Ge同位体前駆体について、1 ppm未満の妨害同位体、99.9999% Si-28、EMIS・TDIS・化学変換工程と、SIPRCの2028年段階稼働予定を追加しました。材料純度とdevice性能・量産時期は分離しています。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds quantum-semiconductor precursor evidence covering contaminant isotopes below 1 ppm, 99.9999% Si-28, EMIS, TDIS, and chemical conversion, plus SIPRC's planned phased operation from 2028. Material purity is kept separate from device performance and volume availability. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 量子半導体向け高純度同位体材料と供給能力
sections.title_en: Isotope-purified materials and supply capacity for quantum semiconductors
sections.summary_ja: Si-28・Ge同位体材料の純度実績、前駆体gas化、米国の生産基盤整備を、device性能と分けて評価します。
sections.summary_en: Assess demonstrated Si-28 and germanium isotope purity, precursor-gas conversion, and U.S. production infrastructure separately from device performance.

items.name_ja: Si-29・Ge-73を1 ppm未満に抑えたsilane・germane前駆体
items.name_en: Silane and germane precursors with Si-29 and Ge-73 below 1 ppm
items.timing_ja: DOEが2026年7月に研究成果を公表
items.timing_en: Research result announced by DOE in July 2026
items.statement_ja: DOE、ORNL、PNNLは、EMISとTDIS、化学変換・精製を組み合わせ、silane中のSi-29とgermane中のGe-73を1 ppm未満へ低減し、silane中Si-28を99.9999%としたと公表しました。silaneとgermaneは半導体薄膜形成の前駆体ですが、材料純度の値だけからqubitのcoherence、error rate、yield、wafer規模の均一性を導くことはできません。
items.statement_en: DOE, ORNL, and PNNL report combining electromagnetic and thermal-diffusion isotope separation with chemical conversion and purification to reduce Si-29 in silane and Ge-73 in germane below 1 ppm and reach 99.9999% Si-28 in silane. Silane and germane are semiconductor thin-film precursors, but material-purity figures alone do not establish qubit coherence, error rates, yield, or wafer-scale uniformity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 量子・HPC hybridを中長期候補に含める場合、qubit装置だけでなく、同位体材料、前駆体、成膜、検査までを供給網と成熟度の評価対象にする必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: If quantum-HPC hybrids remain a medium- or long-term option, supply-chain and maturity assessment must include isotope feedstocks, precursors, deposition, and metrology, not only qubit systems.
adoption_conditions_ja: 同一材料batchで同位体・化学純度、film均一性、device yield、coherence、error rateを結び付ける。
研究用少量供給と量産可能な年産量、lead time、価格、hazardous-gas handlingを区別する。
single-sourceを避けるため、代替supplier、再精製、在庫、輸送規制を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Link isotopic and chemical purity, film uniformity, device yield, coherence, and error rates for the same material batches.
Distinguish research-scale availability from production-scale annual capacity, lead time, price, and hazardous-gas handling.
Assess alternative suppliers, repurification, inventory, and transport regulation to avoid a single-source dependency.

items.name_ja: SIPRCは2028年から段階稼働予定、量子材料の生産規模は未公表
items.name_en: SIPRC targets phased operation from 2028, but quantum-material production scale is undisclosed
items.statement_ja: DOEはORNLのStable Isotope Production and Research Center（SIPRC）が2028年に段階稼働を開始するとしています。既存EMIS設備ではSi-28、Ge-76等の生産能力を実証したと説明していますが、量子半導体向け各同位体・前駆体の年産量、顧客別配分、価格、品質保証、full-scale稼働時期は公表資料から確認できません。したがって2028年は供給開始の可能性を示すfacility milestoneであり、量産deviceの利用可能時期ではありません。
items.statement_en: DOE states that ORNL's Stable Isotope Production and Research Center will begin phased operation in 2028 and that existing EMIS equipment has demonstrated production of Si-28, Ge-76, and other isotopes. The public material does not disclose annual capacity by quantum-semiconductor isotope or precursor, allocation, price, quality assurance, or the date of full-scale operation. The 2028 date is therefore a facility milestone indicating potential supply expansion, not a date for volume quantum-device availability.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 量子計算を整備計画に含める際は、2028年の施設稼働とdevice採用時期の間に、材料認定、成膜、device試作、信頼性評価のgateを置く必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: A quantum-computing plan should place material qualification, deposition, device prototyping, and reliability gates between the 2028 facility milestone and any system-adoption date.
adoption_conditions_ja: SIPRCのphase別設備、供給品目、capacity、qualification scheduleを追跡する。
材料supplierからdevice manufacturerまでのchain of custodyと品質証明を定義する。
同位体純度による性能向上を、従来材料の同一device processと比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Track SIPRC equipment, products, capacity, and qualification schedules by phase.
Define chain of custody and quality certificates from isotope supplier to device manufacturer.
Compare performance from isotope purification against conventional material under the same device process.
